description:
The token order in the footer was fixed (↑ ↓ R W), but the `$cost` value is never shown because cost is never calculated.

**CURRENT STATE (Elixir footer):**
```
↑1.8k ↓106 1.0%/197k (auto)
```
No cost. `footer.cost` is always `0.0`, so `maybe_add_section(parts, cost > 0, ...)` never adds it.

**EXPECTED (Node.js footer):**
```
↑5.4k ↓599 $0.003 1.3%/197k (auto)
```
Where `$0.003` is `$#{totalCost.toFixed(3)}` — three decimal places, variable per-call.

**Why cost is always 0 in Elixir:**
`apps/octo_pi_ai_openai/lib/octo_pi/ai/providers/openai/decoder.ex` `apply_usage/2` sets `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`, `total_tokens` but never touches `usage.cost`. The `%OctoPi.AI.Usage.Cost{}` struct stays at all-zeros.

**Upstream calculation (`tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/src/models.ts` `calculateCost/2`):**
```typescript
usage.cost.input     = (model.cost.input     / 1_000_000) * usage.input;
usage.cost.output    = (model.cost.output    / 1_000_000) * usage.output;
usage.cost.cacheRead = (model.cost.cacheRead / 1_000_000) * usage.cacheRead;
usage.cost.cacheWrite= (model.cost.cacheWrite/ 1_000_000) * usage.cacheWrite;
usage.cost.total     = sum of the four above;
```
`model.cost.{input,output,cacheRead,cacheWrite}` are per-million-token rates in dollars.

**Upstream display:**
- Shown only when `totalCost > 0 || usingSubscription`
- Format: `$${totalCost.toFixed(3)}` — three decimal places
- When using OAuth subscription and cost is 0: shows `"$0.000 (sub)"` (the `(sub)` suffix is for Claude Code OAuth, not applicable here)

**Fix needed:**
1. Add `calculate_cost(model, usage)` to `OctoPi.AI.Model` mirroring upstream
2. Call it at end of `apply_usage/2` in the decoder (model must be threaded in from the producer call site)
3. The Elixir `%Model.Cost{}` struct already has `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write` fields for the per-million rates — wire them up

**Elixir footer format:**
`"$#{:erlang.float_to_binary(cost, decimals: 3)}"` — already correct format, just needs non-zero cost data flowing in.
title: TUI-2: Missing cost/token display in status bar
